summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, the non-US analogue of a US Form 8-K) containing a press release dated October 14, 2026, announcing the appointment of Lapo Pistelli to its Board of Directors, effective immediately. The appointment was made pursuant to Eni S.p.A.'s board nomination right acquired through its earlier strategic investment supporting the Matawinie Mine financing package. No financial terms, stake percentages, prices, premiums, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. NMG frames the appointment as strengthening its relationship with Eni as construction advances at Matawinie and a Final Investment Decision on the 13ktpy Bécancour Battery Material Plant approaches. This is a routine, non-abrupt board appointment, not a special situation; no deal terms were stated.
